notes: Soldered to the board and not upgradable, per Lenovo's spec sheet (https://psrefstuff.lenovo.com/syspool/Sys/PDF/IdeaPad/IdeaPad_5_15ALC05/IdeaPad_5_15ALC05_Spec.pdf), which says 16 GB models run dual channel. This machine reports 13.6 GB usable, which fits 16 GB with about 2 GB reserved for graphics. The module details were not read directly; `sudo dmidecode -t memory` would confirm them.
